name: Rancho Valencia
insider_take: This secluded Spanish colonial haven sits on 45 acres of rolling hills dotted with casitas, where luxury meets laid-back California charm in one of the wealthiest zip codes in America.
whats_special: Rancho Valencia is the only 5-star resort in San Diego County, featuring individual casitas with private patios and fireplaces. The property boasts an award-winning tennis program with 18 championship courts and has hosted celebrities seeking ultimate privacy. The on-site Serenity Spa by Westgate offers treatments in a serene eucalyptus grove setting.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at Veladora restaurant's outdoor terrace during citrus season (winter months) when the surrounding groves are in bloom for an enchanting aromatic dining experience.
dont_miss: The resort's croquet lawn for a quintessentially elegant afternoon activity, and the nearby San Dieguito River Park for hiking trails that showcase Southern California's native chaparral landscape. Rancho Santa Fe village, just minutes away, offers charming boutiques in original 1920s buildings designed to resemble a Spanish colonial town.
pros: Exclusive hacienda-style casitas set among lush, fragrant gardens offer unmatched privacy and romance
World-class tennis facilities with 18 courts make it a top destination for tennis enthusiasts
Award-winning spa delivering transformative treatments in a serene, nature-immersed setting
Farm-to-table dining at Veladora showcases locally sourced California cuisine in an elegant al fresco atmosphere
Stunning Southern California climate and beautifully manicured grounds create a year-round resort escape
cons: Secluded location in Rancho Santa Fe requires a car or transportation to reach local attractions and beaches
Ultra-luxury positioning comes with a premium price point that may not suit all budgets
